subject.title: fix: require admin for keyed session model changes [AI]

question: Should a write-scoped caller that supplies an existing explicit session key lose the ability to change that session’s selected model or thinking level through `sessions.create`?
rationale: This is an intentional compatibility and authorization-policy change rather than a mechanically determined bug fix; the current main behavior permits the call, while the repository’s Gateway guidance frames session keys as routing controls rather than user-isolation boundaries.

options.title: Align adopted creates with admin-only updates
options.body: Keep the PR’s state-aware check so model and thinking changes to an existing keyed session require `operator.admin`, with explicit proof and upgrade communication for write-scoped clients.

options.title: Preserve the write-scoped keyed workflow
options.body: Retain current `sessions.create` authorization and only add a new restriction after maintainers define a narrower supported security boundary.

recommendation.title: Align adopted creates with admin-only updates
recommendation.body: Keep the PR’s state-aware check so model and thinking changes to an existing keyed session require `operator.admin`, with explicit proof and upgrade communication for write-scoped clients.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent, focused history on the affected Gateway authorization surface; a repository owner should make the final policy call.
